Return Policy

We accept returns within 7 days of delivery.

How to Return

  1. Email support@escapeclothing.shop with your order number
  2. We will provide return instructions and address
  3. Ship the product back in original packaging
  4. Refund or exchange processed after inspection

Conditions

  • Items must be unused with tags attached
  • Innerwear and customized items are non-returnable
  • Return shipping may be borne by customer unless product is defective
